# Preface {.unnumbered}

This booklet contains the lecture notes for EC 325: Econometrics at Colby College.

These notes are meant to supplement the course readings.

The content in this book is heavily inspired by three main texts, which are required for this course:

1. @wooldridge_introductory_2019
2. @angrist_mastering_2014
3. @wickham_r_2023
